pr_title: Export project dialog initial path is now set correctly
pr_body:
Fixes #31427. (I think)

- Due to just saving specifically the export path as relative, we must convert it back to an absolute path before calling set_current_path on the export_project variable, otherwise it'll be set to the res:// path.
pr_comments:
I don't really like the amount of code this is adding, especially to String.
This issue is starting to get too complex for the simple purpose of saving one single path as relative, I'll see if I can figure out a cleaner way to do it (not saying that this isn't the right solution, but it doesn't feel right, so I want to investigate before merging).

issue_context.title: File dialog gets stuck on the path of the first selected preset in export dialog
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
afecc0b


**Issue description:**
On the "Export" dialog, the first selected preset's export path will always be the one showing in the file dialog when exporting a project, while selecting others unable to change it.

From the testing I did, the problem seems to be with the `EditorFileDialog` itself, as the select paths are sent to it, but it fails to acknowledge them. Here's the line if anyone want to try their luck:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/afecc0bc2283dfbfbce70ae95c28e0ed4ecd4160/editor/project_export.cpp#L944
comments:
I Cannot reproduce this on the latest master ...

![test](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4707543/63910665-a55cbe80-c9f5-11e9-9cdc-f75c4bf9760b.gif)
It happens in the file dialog, not in the export dialog.
Will work on it this weekend starting today. Thanks for the catch!

@YeldhamDev I'm having trouble either reproducing or understanding the issue. Do you mean that when both paths are set (assuming theres 2 total), and when pressing the path button, the path thats default is not the one from the currently selected export path?
By the way, that line was reverted sometime ago. Is it possible thats fixed now?

> I'm having trouble either reproducing or understanding the issue.

Consider that you have multiple export presets, and each one has a different export path.
The first time you click in "Export Preset", the file dialog will correctly set its path to export path of the preset, but it will make it get stuck in said path, so this in any other preset will always show that first path.

> By the way, that line was reverted sometime ago.

The commit that commented that line out was closed.

> The commit that commented that line out was closed.

I was talking about the commit that I made that reverted the line you transcribed in the your first post. That whole if block was reverted by my merge request. (#31586)
The code in "editor/editor_export.cpp" is actually what's causing the bug.
